name: Mou Yi Zhong Qing Chun
source:
"A Certain Youth" (Mou 1 Zhong Qing Chun) is a slice-of-life campus visual novel set in Yuren High School, a school known for its diverse and eccentric student clubs.

The protagonist serves as the vice president of the "Rush to the Cafeteria Club," a seemingly nonsensical group dedicated to the art of sprinting for lunch. However, the club's future is threatened when the school decides to cut funding for various organizations.

As the protagonist and his friends struggle to save their beloved club, they must navigate the challenges of high school life, student council pressure, and personal growth. The game features 5+1 branching storylines, exploring different perspectives of youth and the various choices students make during their second year of high school.
